title: Peptide Party — Amino Acids & Proteins
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B amino acids and proteins in seven modes: Amino Acids & R Groups, Condense & Hydrolyze, Codon Decoder, Name That Peptide, Protein Structure, R-Group Interactions, and Exam Practice. Students build peptides by tapping the –OH and H that leave as water, cut peptide bonds by adding water, translate mRNA with a codon chart, name peptides with 3- and 1-letter codes, identify primary to quaternary structure from diagrams, and match side-chain pairs to salt bridges, hydrogen bonds, disulfide bonds and hydrophobic interactions. Exam Practice serves 65 final-exam style questions from Final Boss.
